name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Model Context Protocol Servers - Enhance AI
short_description: The Model Context Protocol Servers enable integration and management of AI models, enhancing their deployment and performance. Built with TypeScript, this repository supports developers in creating strong AI applications.
author: modelcontextprotocol

sections.overview:
The Model Context Protocol Servers repository is a collection of reference server implementations designed for developers building AI agent skills and integrations. It provides the foundational code and patterns needed to create servers compatible with Claude, Cursor, and other AI platforms that support the Model Context Protocol. Developers can use these implementations as examples and building blocks for extending AI agent capabilities with custom tools and integrations. The repository is actively maintained with TypeScript implementations and supports both official and community-driven server development. This resource helps developers standardize how they expose tools and resources to AI agents through the MCP specification.
Deploy AI models in production environments with minimal downtime.
Integrate multiple AI services to create a cohesive application ecosystem.
Optimize model performance through resource management and scaling.
Manage server resources efficiently to ensure high availability of AI applications.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: GitHub Copilot, VS Code
